title: stelis thomasiae
intro: Stelis thomasiae, commonly known as the Thomasia orchid, is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, respiratory issues, and gastrointestinal problems. The therapeutic actions of Stelis thomasiae include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its potential health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant are still being researched, but it is believed to contain flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
